reason: The plugin conservatively scans local Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata, aggregates activity, and recommends DSH agent presets without network requests, LLM calls, preset changes, or discovered-command execution.

summaries.zh: 扫描本地编码智能体的会话、项目和工作流元数据，并根据确定性规则生成持久化的 DSH 智能体预设建议。
summaries.en: Scans local coding-agent session, project, and workflow metadata to produce persistent DSH agent preset recommendations using deterministic rules.

capabilities: Bounded local scanning of supported coding-agent session, project, and workflow metadata
Aggregate persistence of counts, dates, recommendations, and keyed project identifiers
Deterministic recommendations for DSH capability presets and optional capabilities
Agent-facing tools for refreshing scans and retrieving saved recommendations
